verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are stored as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files on your device, which you control, can use offline, and can open in other apps. Community users corroborate the file ownership: notes live locally, can outlive the app, and even Canvas files use an open, MIT-licensed JSON format that stays local. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that every feature works fully offline, and Canvas JSON is reportedly less human-readable than Markdown.
